title: Accessing Peekbank Data

Data hosted versioned peekbank dataset Redivis; client retrieves tidy tables without write queries. vignette shows examples use data loading functions resulting data look like. Every table release field client, holding whole table: pb$datasets pb$subjects pb$administrations pb$trials pb$trial_types pb$stimuli pb$aoi_region_sets pb$aoi_timepoints pb$xy_timepoints work part release, pb$subset$<table>() takes dplyr expressions. timepoint tables, far large narrow locally, run server. Technical note 1: first request open browser window authorize Redivis access (set REDIVIS_API_TOKEN). Technical note 2: Start creating client peekbank(). pins database version whole analysis, every table read comes version. version required, Peekbank re-released time unpinned script quietly reads different data releases land. Pass "current" want whichever version newest, always highest release number. older connect_to_peekbank() / get_*(connection = con) style still works. Technical note 3: tried optimize time takes get data database (AOI timepoints transfer run-length-encoded expanded locally). query entire timepoint tables, still take , transferring 100s MB data.
